sanctions/script/DE.record:
History: The Council adopted draft S/2022/925 14–0–1 as resolution 2664 (2022). Brazil voted yes and India abstained. India asked for a proactive role for the 1267 Monitoring Team and robust reporting. It said those concerns were not fully addressed in the adopted text.
Workshop: AGREEMENT_POSSIBLE F
Evidence: Package F proposes that the ERC convene, with aggregate public reporting annually.
Positions: India accepts F in the workshop (claim-8). Brazil accepts F in the workshop (claim-7).
Authority: Workshop proposals are fictional. They neither amend the resolution nor record an official decision.

membership/script/AB.record:
History: At its 9609th meeting the Council voted 12–1–2 on draft S/2024/312. France voted yes and the United Kingdom abstained. The negative United States vote prevented adoption. France supported elevating Palestine to full United Nations membership in the context of advancing the two-State solution. The United Kingdom linked its abstention to prioritizing an immediate humanitarian pause for aid and hostage releases, followed by work toward a sustainable ceasefire. It reaffirmed support for a two-State solution.
Workshop: IMPASSE
Evidence: Every one of the 7 offered packages was excluded by at least one delegate.
Positions: France excludes F in the workshop (claim-6). United Kingdom excludes G in the workshop (claim-7).
Authority: The draft would recommend admission. A Council recommendation precedes the General Assembly’s decision under Article 4. Workshop notes confer neither membership nor bilateral recognition.
